Dynamic installation metadata / combined P + C release

EXE: DWAgent-dynamic-10443-v2-x64.exe
Portal: https://82.25.46.70:10443/
Configuration: os_win_installer/install-dynamic-10443-v2.json

The same isolated portal manages P, process filenames, Windows service name,
service display name, installation folder, and Installed Apps Publisher.
Only P and C appear on the installer credential screen. Both are required.
P is cleared after submission. C retries require fresh P authorization, and
already installed components retain their saved names/path/publisher.

Path blank: actual Windows Program Files / selected service name.
Custom path: new subfolders under the actual Windows Program Files directory,
for example %ProgramFiles%\Company\Agent. Existing vendor folders, junctions,
network drives, and folders outside Program Files are refused. Program Files
is resolved through Windows rather than inherited environment variables.
UTF-16 path length is bounded for the selected service name and native buffers.
Publisher changes the Installed Apps entry. UAC Publisher requires code signing.

New clients request install_identity_version 2. Older 10443 clients retain the
original four-field API response. The EXE contains only DWAgent naming defaults;
custom portal metadata requires P and the independent built-in client credential.
An embedded credential remains extractable from a distributed EXE.

Validation:
- 139 Python tests passed: 77 installer and 62 portal/client tests.
- Native service registration and Publisher registry/property tests passed;
  registry testing used an isolated temporary HKCU key, not installed apps.
- Custom Unicode Publisher and default Publisher fallback verified.
- Live HTTPS, both credentials, P-only responses, legacy four-field compatibility,
  metadata v2, cookie isolation, restart persistence and immediate revocation passed.
- Temporary live-test P and session removed after each test run.
- Earlier listeners/process IDs, original source/unit files and password records
  compared unchanged before/after each isolated 10443 update.
- All 35 earlier EXEs retain their recorded SHA256 hashes.
- Extracted final payload matches the current installer source/native binary,
  parses as Python 3.8, and contains no server-specific custom names.
- Combined P/C form visually checked using a preview with elevation/install disabled.
- Actual Windows Program Files API read succeeded on this PC.
- No DWAgent was installed, stopped, renamed or removed during this work.

Artifacts:
SHA256SUMS-dynamic-10443-v2.txt
portal-dynamic-10443-v2-source.zip

Deployment/verification records: make/tmp/dynamic-10443-v2/
The isolated service remains remo-dynamic-portal.service; only it was restarted.
Earlier EXEs and their configuration files were preserved.
